name: How do you prevent mold growth after water damage?

mainEntity.name: How do you prevent mold growth after water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing mold growth is a primary focus during water damage cleanup. This is achieved by thorough water extraction and rapid drying of all affected materials using industrial-grade air movers and dehumidifiers. We also apply antimicrobial treatments to surfaces to inhibit mold spores. Maintaining proper ventilation and ensuring that moisture levels are returned to normal are crucial steps to create an environment where mold cannot thrive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold is prevented by thorough water extraction, rapid drying with specialized equipment, and applying antimicrobial treatments to affected areas.
